versions.changelog: No user-facing changes in this version; version number was incremented without file or documentation changes.

- Initial release of china-image-gen, enabling text-to-image generation in China without VPN via SiliconFlow API.
- Supports FLUX.1-schnell (fast/free), FLUX.1-dev (high quality), Kolors (best Chinese prompt handling), and SD3 (accurate text rendering).
- Easy setup with Chinese phone registration; payment via Alipay/WeChat; new users receive free quota.
- Provides prompt optimization tips, model selection guidance, and example API calls using curl.
- Includes output formatting, common error handling, and important usage notes (e.g., 1-hour image URL validity).
